verses.restored: O give thanks to YHWH; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

original.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

original.text: יֹֽאמַר נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

original.text: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֥א בֵֽית אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Let them now that fear YHWH say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

original.text: יֹֽאמְרוּ נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: I called upon YHWH in distress: YHWH answered me, and set me in a large place.

familiar.text: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

modern.text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.

original.text: מִֽן הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ

verses.restored: YHWH is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do to me?

familiar.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

modern.text: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

familiar.text: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

modern.text: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.

original.text: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי

verses.restored: It is better to trust in YHWH than to put confidence in man.

familiar.text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

modern.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

original.text: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם

verses.restored: It is better to trust in YHWH than to put confidence in princes.

familiar.text: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

modern.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

original.text: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים

verses.restored: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of YHWH will I destroy them.

familiar.text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

modern.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

original.text: כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם

verses.restored: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of YHWH I will destroy them.

familiar.text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

modern.text: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

original.text: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם

verses.restored: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of YHWH I will destroy them.

familiar.text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

modern.text: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

original.text: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם

verses.restored: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but YHWH helped me.

familiar.text: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

modern.text: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

original.text: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי

verses.restored: YHWH is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

familiar.text: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

modern.text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.

original.text: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה

verses.restored: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of YHWH doeth valiantly.

familiar.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

modern.text: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!

original.text: ק֤וֹל רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל

verses.restored: The right hand of YHWH is exalted: the right hand of YHWH doeth valiantly.

familiar.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

modern.text: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”

original.text: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל

verses.restored: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of YHWH.

familiar.text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

modern.text: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.

original.text: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ

verses.restored: YHWH hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over to death.

familiar.text: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

modern.text: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.

original.text: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי

verses.restored: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise YHWH:

familiar.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

modern.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.

original.text: פִּתְחוּ לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ

verses.restored: This gate of YHWH, into which the righteous shall enter.

familiar.text: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

modern.text: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.

original.text: זֶֽה הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ

verses.restored: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

familiar.text: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

modern.text: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.

original.text: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה

verses.restored: The stone the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.

familiar.text: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

notes.title: Rejected stone
notes.body: The rejected-stone line became important in later Jewish and Christian reception, including the New Testament. The psalm’s original liturgical setting should remain visible alongside later applications.

modern.text: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

original.text: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה

verses.restored: This is YHWH’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

familiar.text: This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

modern.text: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

original.text: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: This is the day which YHWH hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

familiar.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

modern.text: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

original.text: זֶה הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ

verses.restored: Save now, I beseech thee, O YHWH: O YHWH, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

familiar.text: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

modern.text: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!

original.text: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא

verses.restored: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of YHWH; we bless you from the house of YHWH.

familiar.text: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

notes.title: Blessed is the one who comes
notes.body: This liturgical blessing is later used in the Gospel entry traditions. The source psalm and later messianic reception should be shown as related layers, not collapsed into one historical moment.

modern.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.

original.text: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: God is YHWH, which hath showed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

familiar.text: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

modern.text: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.

original.text: אֵ֤ל יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

familiar.text: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

modern.text: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.

original.text: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: O give thanks to YHWH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Victory and enemy language must not authorize violence; later messianic readings should remain visible without erasing the psalm’s liturgical setting.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
